reply_text:
Found two issues in `receipt-lines` against `main`:

1. **[P1] Printed amounts are 100× too large** — `receipt/render.py:2`  
   `format_money` formats cents directly as dollars: `format_money(1299)` returns `$1299.00`, not `$12.99`. Two coffees at 450 cents print as `$900.00` instead of `$9.00`. Convert cents to dollars before formatting. The current test misses this because it uses the same formatter to compute its expected result; add literal expected-dollar assertions.

2. **[P2] Receipt rendering bypasses right-alignment** — `receipt/render.py:7`  
   The new 32-column `align()` helper isn’t used by `render_line`. Amounts start at a fixed column instead of ending at one, so different-length prices have ragged right edges. Route rendering through the helper and test that different amounts end at column 32.

**Validation:** All 3 existing tests pass; both issues reproduced directly. Reviewed through `a6c40d4`. No files changed.

I’d fix these before merging.
